title: Footer Code - HTML Snippet of Website Footer
text:
## Footer Code - HTML Snippet of Website Footer
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000096168
This article provides a sample HTML structure for the default Website Footer included in the standard Brilliant Directories website theme.
The example demonstrates the default layout and commonly used HTML elements, CSS classes, and responsive components that make up the website footer, including the footer navigation, social media links, call-to-action button, and copyright section.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12132163578/original/JrKGtzx3-ZvUUg2WU-Xr372zNqZL1r88gg.png?1696283152 | alt: ]
The following HTML snippet represents the default markup for the Website Footer.
This code can be used as a reference when creating custom footer layouts, modifying the default website footer, or identifying the HTML elements and CSS classes used by the standard Brilliant Directories theme.
